question: Select the **INCORRECTLY** spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Percist**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Percist**: This is an incorrectly spelled word.
 
• The correct spelling of this word should be '**Persist**', which means to continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action despite difficulty or opposition. (दृढ़ रहना or जारी रहना)
 
 
• ​**Example**: *Despite facing challenges, she chose to persist in her efforts to achieve her goals.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Percist**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

• **Strict**: to enforce rules or standards rigorously and demand adherence to them. (कठोर or सख्त)
 
• **Repair**: Fixing or mending something that is broken or damaged. (मरम्मत or ठीक करना)
